therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: PONV Clinical Decision Support System (automated AIMS notifications + email recommendations)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: improved adherence to evidence-based PONV prophylaxis protocols
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adult patients undergoing elective surgery under general anesthesia at Vanderbilt University Medical Center
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Adherence to PONV Guidelines (percentage of patients receiving the exact recommended number of prophylactic interventions)

results.effect_size: Adherence: Baseline 666 patients adherent vs CDS Email 5260 vs CDS Email + Real-Time 5863 (count of participants meeting guideline)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Automated notifications delivered within AIMS at case start, surgery start, and surgery end; preoperative emails sent via PDW
safety_signals: Mortality: Baseline 7/1518; CDS Email 43/12809; CDS Email + Real-Time 40/12707 — rates comparable across phases

compounds: Automated recommendation at the start of the case
Automated notification at the start of surgery
Automated notification at the end of surgery

results_by_chain.intervention: Automated recommendation at the start of the case
results_by_chain.mechanism_description: real-time algorithmic guideline prompting at decision point
results_by_chain.biology_description: improved clinical guideline adherence through behavioral nudging
results_by_chain.population_description: adult patients undergoing elective surgery under general anesthesia
